context.qualifier: Engineering train/dev sanity test only; neither native Yggdrasil nor real original MiniGrid/Pycolab cognition
hard_stops: No original sources or original-source API imports
No production database, controller, queue, protected research seeds or signed ledger writes
known_negatives: S4C1 exact checkpoint first-use NO-GO remains
Q14 global original reset custody NO-GO remains

generator.latent: z[t] Bernoulli(0.5) initially; for t>0 independently flips with training-family hazard h
generator.prediction: p(z[t]=1 | x[0:t]) after receiving x[t]; no z[t] or family ID at inference
generator.supervision: z[t] labels available to all algorithms for fully supervised TRAIN fitting only

ordinary_recurrent.name: TANH_RNN
ordinary_recurrent.train: same fully supervised BPTT and Adam

bayesian.name: TRAINED_BAYES_FILTER
bayesian.architecture: exact binary posterior filter with pooled train-fit noise/hazard ML estimates, no family access at inference
bayesian.train: one complete closed-form likelihood fit using same labeled train sequences

symbolic.name: TRAINED_SYMBOLIC_MAJORITY
symbolic.architecture: running integer cue sum and Bernoulli calibration fitted from complete train cohort
symbolic.train: 2-parameter logistic fit by Adam on exact same train labels

current.name: TRAINED_CURRENT_ONLY_LOGISTIC
current.architecture: logistic fitted with just x[t], no history
current.train: 2-parameter logistic fit by Adam on exact same train labels

optimizer.checkpoint_selection: lowest equal-episode mean validation cross-entropy at epoch 80 only, tie to earliest restart; no held selection
optimizer.loss: binary log loss nats, clipped predictive probability [1e-9,1-1e-9]
optimizer.cost: Per-model train process_time, inference process_time, tracemalloc Python peak, 1-scalar inference state, trained parameters and serialized checkpoint bytes; do not interpret platform timing as inherent theoretical compute.

gate.train: Train all five predeclared models on EXACT same source-free train observations+labels; validation used for checkpoint selection only
gate.decision: DEV_ADVANCE_ONLY if candidate validation NLL improves >=0.010 nats/step vs best of ordinary-recurrent, Bayesian, symbolic and current; improves on both dev families; matches one-scalar state budget; and recorded candidate fit + infer CPU <= 1.05 times tanh RNN on same OS. Otherwise DEV_NO_GO_STOP_BEFORE_FUTURE_HOLDOUT
gate.preheld_future_holdout: No F_C or F_D generation, loss, source or tuning in Q15 under ANY outcome
gate.retention: Log all model NLLs, mean per-family results, all positive and negative criteria, checksum source/tool identity, deterministic role-separated train/dev hashes.
